model: MoSQITo 1.2.1 ISO 532-1:2017 time-varying Zwicker, free field, peak of mean separate-channel loudness

configuration.onsetMethod: 10ms combined-channel mean-power RMS windows, 1ms step, first window crossing -30dB relative to maximum window RMS in first500ms; search first250ms; preserve2ms lead-in; apply only starts>5ms.
configuration.renderer: first cycle starts at playbackStartFrame; later loops use full original; scipy resample_poly denominator<=2048

metadata.calibrationAssumption: Digital RMS0.1 maps to assumed60dBSPL. Public-device physical SPL is not calibrated.
metadata.channelAggregation: Arithmetic mean of separate-channel ISO532-1 loudness histories, then maximum over time.
metadata.rendering: first cycle starts at playbackStartFrame; later loops use full original; scipy resample_poly denominator<=2048

domainPadding.method: Expanded coordinate hull; original sampled ratios preserved; endpoint response independently checked.

metadata.interpolation: linear seconds, log pitch, gain dB, natural-log sones

interpolationValidation.method: Fresh ISO532 model reevaluation of C# solved gain cases across the stated tested conditions.
interpolationValidation.scope: Tested conditions only, not exhaustive continuous-grid interpolation or physical-device conformance.

endpointValidation.basis: Checked -24,-6,0dB endpoint responses are retained identically from source profile.

nominalLimitations: Model uses ideal continuous linear fade and scipy resampling, not recorded Unity output.
Separate-channel mean peak is not a binaural or individual-hearing model.
